answer: Audits are published in umber, queued in anchor, and zephyr publishes the wait time. A farm of 361 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 50 identities per epoch. A farm of 3247 identities would post 1207 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
